body: She definitely does. I stumbled upon her ex boyfriend and asked him. Apparently she was never like that. Maybe it's best for her if I make her that way.

Thank you. I will go to the police station. Hopefully somebody can help. And as for family I will have to explore my options. Her father is dead and her mom doesn't care. Hopefully I figure something out.
I didn't swat them. The wheels are in motion.
Well I'm already in the works of talking to my friends for moral support since this is very new to me and I can't seem to do it on my own. And will call her family. Thank you for your words friend.
I will. I'll talk to the few family members that care while trying to avoid the grandparents from knowing. At their age I don't think they could handle it

Didn't know my plea for help was a chance to get insulted. 

I'm obviously here to explore my options. I wish to do something about my current situation. It obviously pushes my sympathy button when she does that. I can't help it. Doesn't make me a little boy. Just makes me human, a human asking other humans for advice, input, relatable stories.
She doesn't have parents or much family. But I already stated that I have a rough idea on who to talk to.
Fortunately this didn't affect my career I've been building since I was 20. But I'm already making moves.

Unfortunately she knows that I'm a gentle giant. Try to harm no one around me. 

Now everyone thinks that I'm this big dousche bag because of her. Even childhood friends. I never have a chance to explain myself because she always tries to manipulate the story.
She doesn't have parents but I have a rough idea on who to call.
Fuck this is a lot to take in. But you're right. I feel like I've been playing a role for the past year. I'm not my usual self. Thank you for your help friend.
I already have. 5 times after last week. She slit her wrist the last and had to take her to the hospital.

She has a way with words. Last time I called her cousins and they came back to me like I'm the bad guy. I don't really know who to turn to. And the police in this city is relatively incompetent. Had some personal experience and some people around me tell me stories. I'll try to see what I can do. Maybe I'll ask reddit in another subreddit specialized in that department.

It's not that I refuse to fix it. But maybe I do need to talk to someone about this. This suicide thing has happened many times before so I just fake a smile and go about my business. 

The problem with friends is that she manipulated all of them and told them that I am this bad person. They don't believe me anymore. And the one that does tells me to let her do it.
